abstract: Adobe's 2024 survey of creative professionals finds widespread AI adoption in the creative workforce, with three-quarters of respondents using AI tools. However, the survey reveals a significant concern: approximately one-third of creative professionals report that AI has diminished the scope of work they are hired to perform, suggesting both opportunities and displacement risks in creative industries.
keyFindings: 74% of creative professionals report using AI tools in their work
30% of creative professionals say AI has reduced the scope of work they're hired for
AI adoption is widespread but accompanied by concerns about reduced work scope among creative professionals
methodology: Survey of creative professionals; specific sample size, geographic scope, and detailed methodology not provided in excerpt. Data collected February 2024.
qualifiers: Limited source excerpt available; complete methodology, confidence intervals, and full findings not accessible. Results based on self-reported data from survey respondents.
